essence: The practitioner should extend the tip of the yoni by the measure of two barley-grains.
One should make the outer rim beginning from the outer place.
The perforated feature is connected in both places as stated.
The meaning is that it extends from the middle up to the middle limit.
The knowing practitioner should likewise make a second hole upon the rim.
